8.5. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.element¶

The module defines utility functions for nodes, indices and objects.

Functions

containsBentSwitchLeg(nodeIndex) Check if nodeIndex contains a bent switch leg.
containsStraightSwitchLeg(nodeIndex) Check if nodeIndex contains a straight switch leg.
createPath(subtype, name, start_node, edges) Convenience function to create a path.
graphObjIter(graph) Iterator over objects contained in the nodes of the graph.
inObjIter(railyard) Iterator over inner railyard objects.
nodeBoundaryIter(area) Make an iterator that returns nodes on the boundary of the area.
nodeIter(path) Iterator over nodes in the path.
oppositeNode(node, edge) Calculate opposite node on edge
outObjIter(railyard) Iterator over outer railyard objects.
sortedNodes(graph) i Returns a sorted list of the nodes in the graph graph
